answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 20674 Country: Bangladesh Title: Hazrat if i join jammat (takbir-e-tahrima) when imam saheb starts to salam(1st) "Assala..." but does not complete. In this context am i supposed to get into the jammat or not? Question: Sallat Assalamu a'laikum. Hazrat if i join jammat (takbir-e-tahrima) when imam saheb starts to salam(1st) "Assala..." but does not complete. In this context am i supposed to get into the jammat or not? Answer ID: 20674 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 531/415/B=1431) Salah completes on the mim of assalamu . If you joined Imam by saying takbir tahrima before he pronounced mim you will be counted as participant of Jamaat , but not if you joined after the pronunciation of the letter mim . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
